content.title: The Score: Campbell’s, Kohl’s, Alphabet and More Stocks That Defined the Week
content.summary: Campbell’s fired an executive this past week after he was allegedly caught on tape saying the company made “highly processed food” for “poor people.”  “The comments were vulgar, offensive and false, and we apologize for the hurt they have caused,” the company said Wednesday.  Investors sent the two tech leaders trading in opposite directions during Tuesday’s session, with Nvidia shares falling 2.6% and Google parent Alphabet rising 1.6%.
